$comment: How ShinyQ HQ itself was built (owner request 2026-10-15). Knowledge for the Ask the HQ chatbot only: this file is not rendered; the long form is the /build page (content/build-story.json). It becomes one knowledge chunk (`site-build`) that is always retrieved for questions about this site (`isSiteQuestion` in functions/_lib/scope.ts), and an answer to such a question cites the /build page (`SITE_BUILD_PAGE` in src/ask/pack.ts), which links `source`, the public repository. Facts only, third person, verified against the repository; never a client company (C3), a cloud resource name, a hostname or a number that is not in the repository. It covers the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates, the visitor controls, per-page URLs and ?view=classic, the Study Vault, the secret B1 Engine Room and the Agent Office (what it shows and its privacy rule, never its live data). Update it in the same PR when the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates or the visitor controls (Rover, floors, minimap, settings, links) change. Validated by SiteBuildSchema (src/content/schema.ts) and the forbidden-pattern lint (scripts/validate-fragment.ts).

text.en: Kurniadi built ShinyQ HQ from October 2026: AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) implemented his written specs in pull requests he reviewed and merged. Stack: Next.js 16 static export, React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl (English, Indonesian), zod-validated content, built with pinned Bun 1.4 and Node 24. The 3D tower uses three.js via React Three Fiber and zustand, with full, lite or static tiers; the Classic site is the same content as accessible HTML, no WebGL. Hosting: Cloudflare Pages and Functions, KV, R2, Analytics Engine and two Workers (hq-stats refreshes visit stats every hour, hq-office runs the Agent Office). Ask AI opens a separate chat panel, Ask Rover Assistant (internally Ask the HQ): Rover answers in its own voice, about Kurniadi in the third person, only from a curated pack of public site content in KV, and remembers three turns. Models: Gemma 4 on Workers AI via AI Gateway, then Mistral Small 3.1, then Groq, behind Turnstile, rate limits and output checks. Gates: Vitest, Playwright, Lighthouse CI and 3D budgets (draw calls, triangles, JS size, memory); pull requests run only affected checks; nightly runs do everything plus assistant evals. Merges deploy by workflow; red main CI rolls back. Source: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ on GitHub. Rover is a small robot guide: drive it with WASD, arrows or a touch joystick; Shift (or a joystick double-tap) boosts it to double speed. Point-and-go (click, or double-tap on touch) drives to and opens glowing rooms, pads or boards. The elevator serves L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing and the RF roof deck. A first-visit tutorial and hints explain the controls. The Rover menu offers room shortcuts; the minimap (or N) opens a floor overview and destination picker. Settings controls language, motion, graphics, day/night, minimap, sound and music. Pages have shareable URLs; in 3D, a project or floor link goes there. ?view=classic selects the Classic site; an ordinary link follows the recipient's remembered view. The L4 Study Vault opens his certification study guides in an in-site PDF reader (also on the Classic Writing page). Visiting all five public floors unlocks B1 Engine Room in the elevator. Its seven stations mirror the /build page (architecture, rounds, agents, gates, figures, Ask, rejected designs). The Agent Office, in a Lobby wing, shows his AI coding agents live through hooks: Rovers at up to ten desks (two rows of five) with their state and activity. Titles show only for allowlisted public repositories, else "Client project"; code, prompts, file paths and client names never leave his machine. A screen wall adds public GitHub activity; with quiet hooks the office is semi-live. The Classic home shows it as the Live Agent Office card.
text.id: Kurniadi membangun ShinyQ HQ sejak Oktober 2026: AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) mengerjakan spec tertulisnya lewat pull request yang ia review dan merge. Stack: static export Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl (Inggris, Indonesia), konten divalidasi zod; build memakai Bun 1.4 dan Node 24 (dipin). Menara 3D: three.js lewat React Three Fiber dan zustand, tier full, lite atau static; Situs klasik: konten sama dalam HTML aksesibel tanpa WebGL. Hosting: Cloudflare Pages dan Functions, KV, R2, Analytics Engine dan dua Worker (hq-stats memperbarui statistik kunjungan tiap jam, hq-office untuk Agent Office). Tanya AI membuka panel chat terpisah, Asisten Rover (internal: Ask the HQ): Rover menjawab dengan suaranya sendiri tentang Kurniadi (orang ketiga), hanya dari pack konten publik terkurasi di KV, dan mengingat tiga giliran. Model: Gemma 4 di Workers AI lewat AI Gateway, lalu Mistral Small 3.1, lalu Groq, dengan Turnstile, rate limit dan output check. Pengujian: Vitest, Playwright, Lighthouse CI dan budget 3D (draw call, segitiga, ukuran JS, memori); PR memeriksa bagian terdampak, run malam semuanya plus evaluasi asisten. Merge memicu deploy lewat workflow; CI main gagal memicu rollback. Sumber: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ di GitHub. Rover adalah robot pemandu kecil: kemudikan dengan WASD, panah atau joystick sentuh; Shift (atau ketuk dua kali joystick) mempercepatnya jadi 2x. Point-and-go (klik, atau ketuk dua kali di layar sentuh) menuju dan membuka ruangan, pad atau papan bercahaya. Lift melayani L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing dan dek atap RF. Tutorial awal dan petunjuk menjelaskan kontrol. Menu Rover berisi pintasan ruangan; minimap (atau N) membuka peta lantai dan pilihan tujuan. Pengaturan: bahasa, motion, grafis, siang/malam, minimap, suara dan musik. Tiap halaman punya URL untuk dibagikan; di 3D, tautan proyek atau lantai menuju lokasinya. ?view=classic memilih Situs klasik; tautan biasa mengikuti tampilan yang diingat penerima. Study Vault di L4 membuka panduan belajar sertifikasinya di pembaca PDF situs (juga di Writing Situs klasik). Kunjungi kelima lantai publik untuk membuka Ruang Mesin B1 di lift. Tujuh stasiunnya mengikuti halaman /build (arsitektur, putaran, agent, gate, angka, Ask, desain yang ditolak). Agent Office di sayap Lobi menampilkan AI coding agent Kurniadi lewat hook secara live: Rover di maksimal sepuluh meja (dua baris berisi lima) dengan status dan aktivitasnya. Judul hanya tampil untuk repositori publik yang diizinkan, lainnya "Proyek klien"; kode, prompt, path file dan nama klien tak pernah keluar dari mesinnya. Dinding layar menampilkan aktivitas GitHub publik; saat hook sepi, kantor semi-live. Beranda Situs klasik memuat kartu Kantor Agen Live.
